name: Letter maths

text: The notebook opened to a task called "Letter Magic Challenge".
You have 7 minutes to complete the task.
New sentences appeared in the problem:
One has 3.
Three has 5.
Five has 4.
How many does Thirteen have?
Enter a number as your answer.

hint.text: Pay attention to the word "Letter" in the task title.

text: Thirteen has 8 letters.

name: Magical animal

text: Suddenly the notebook opened.
Let's play Wordle. Guess the magical animal. A correct letter in the right place will be green. Correct but in the wrong place – yellow. Wrong – grey.
E.g.: word LATVIA, and you entered LITHUA:
[img source="lietuva.jpg" width="300" height="50"/]
You have 10 attempts (10 points). Each wrong attempt – minus 1 point.
Guess the magical animal mentioned in the young fairy's notebook.
The magical animal is the phoenix.

name: Wand mischief

text: The fairy's wand started to play tricks.
You have 5 minutes to complete the task.

photoValidation.prompt: Ar nuotraukoje yra žmogus ar žmonės.
photoValidation.transformationPrompt: Transform the input photo into a stylized non-photorealistic semi-cartoon illustration using warm beige, ochre, cream and earthy tones with muted greens; simplify details, use flat shading, subtle watercolor texture and clean dark outlines; preserve each person's recognizable appearance, hairstyle, body proportions and original pose. For EACH person individually, preserve their gender presentation from the original photo and apply ONLY matching early-1900s Belle Époque / Edwardian clothing: males wear masculine attire with trousers, tailored suit, waistcoat, tie, overcoat and top hat; females wear feminine attire with a long skirt or dress, fitted blouse or bodice and decorated period hat. Never swap or mix male and female clothing between people. Preserve the number, positions and gender presentation of all people. Maintain a cohesive retro comic watercolor + vector look.

text: The fairy's wand started to play tricks. It carried you back in time — to the year 1923.
To return to the present, take a team photo in which you become the high society of 1923 Kaunas.

name: Magic pencils

text: The backpack opened, and pencils spilled out.
You have 6 minutes to complete the task.
The pencils arranged themselves into a number.
Move two pencils so that you get the smallest possible positive number.
Enter that number as your answer.

hint.text: We moved one pencil — where should the second one go?

text: The answer is 846.
